title: Warm Spiced Squash & Pumpkin Seed Salad
ingredients: 750g butternut squash, peeled, deseeded and cut into small (about 2cm) cubes
Dressing: 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp honey, 1 garlic clove (crushed)
steps: Line a large baking tray with parchment; spray; spread squash cubes out. Sprinkle over paprika, cayenne, cumin and thyme; season; mix to coat. Scatter over pumpkin seeds; spray generously.
Roast 30 minutes until tender with golden brown edges.
Allow to cool slightly. Make dressing: mix balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, honey and garlic.
Empty salad leaves into a large bowl; add contents of baking tray; toss. Drizzle dressing over and serve immediately.
notes: Sweet potato can be used instead of or alongside butternut squash.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
